source_kind_detail: Issuer 'Data Download' workbook (Excel 2003 SpreadsheetML XML served as application/vnd.ms-excel, Content-Disposition filename=iShares-7-10-Year-Treasury-Bond-ETF_fund.xls), worksheet 'Distributions'. Link is the 'Data Download' href on the issuer product page.
fetch_method: python requests GET (sandboxed, no sandbox override needed), browser-like User-Agent

output_columns.amount: Total Distribution (USD per share; equals Income + ST Cap Gains + LT Cap Gains + Return of Capital for every row)

parsing_notes: The workbook is not well-formed XML (an unescaped '&' inside an ss:HRef attribute on the Disclaimers sheet breaks ElementTree), so the 'Distributions' worksheet was extracted by regex over <ss:Row>/<ss:Cell>/<ss:Data> elements; all 289 data rows have 8 cells. Dates parsed with format '%b %d, %Y' (0 failures). amount = 'Total Distribution' column; verified Total == Income+ST+LT+ROC within 1e-6 on every row. No duplicate ex-dates, so no summing was needed. All amounts > 0. Exactly one row carries a non-income component: ex 2009-11-02 total 0.769909 = income 0.260923 + LT cap gain 0.508986, paid in cash and kept. Return of Capital is 0 on every row. No stock splits or non-cash/reinvested distributions appear in the source. Cross-check: the product page HTML embeds the same table server-side (DistributionV3 'distributionTableData'); outer-merge on ex-date matched 289/289 with zero amount mismatches. Coverage: 12 ex-dates in every full calendar year 2003-2025; 5 in 2002 (first ex-date 2002-09-03, ~6 weeks after the 2002-07-22 inception; the issuer file lists no August 2002 distribution); 8 in 2026 through 2026-09-01. Consecutive-ex-date gaps >45 days occur only between mid-December and early February from 2019-12 onward, because the issuer moved the year-end payment to a second December ex-date (no January ex-date), so these are not missing months. All issuer records are retained: 2 records fall after the requested 2026-07-17 cutoff (ex 2026-08-03 and 2026-09-01); last ex-date on or before the cutoff is 2026-07-01. Filter on ex_date if a hard cutoff is required.
